record.question: If the Citizenship (Amendment) Bill, 2016 is passed, illegal migrants from Afghanistan, Pakistan and ________ will then be eligible for Indian citizenship.
record.explanation: Answer A: Bangladesh. The 2016 Citizenship (Amendment) Bill listed Afghanistan, Bangladesh, and Pakistan as the three countries in the proposed eligibility change; Bangladesh is the blank. This is a historical bill question, not a statement of current law. Reference: https://sansad.in/getFile/BillsTexts/LSBillTexts/Asintroduced/2573LS%20(As%20Intro).pdf?source=legislation. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
